title: Double-support load-share backtracking does not improve exploratory cross-collection Parkinson discrimination
abstract: Within-double-support normalized load-share backtracking did not improve Parkinson/control transfer beyond gait timing, double-support duration and force summaries in two previously explored public collections. NDD-to-PDB (163 target people) baseline/augmented log loss was 0.632620/0.633664, paired gain -0.001044 (conditional95% interval [-0.001833, -0.000210]); reverse gain -0.002476. Joint source/target refit intervals include zero in both directions. This is a detector/model-specific negative result, not equivalence or evidence that physiological information is absent.
